raw_answer_text:
A1: It moves to SYN-RECEIVED and sends a SYN,ACK segment.
A2: It enters SYN-SENT and sends a SYN segment (also creating the TCB).
A3: It sends an ACK, and the connection reaches the ESTABLISHED state.
A4: It moves to FIN-WAIT-1 and sends a FIN segment.
A5: It moves to CLOSE-WAIT and sends an ACK.
A6: A CLOSE event moves it to LAST-ACK, at which point the TCP sends a FIN.
A7: The connection moves to CLOSING (after sending an ACK).
A8: It must remain until a timeout of 2MSL elapses before deleting the TCB and moving to CLOSED.
